prompt: Build a workspace settings page in src/pages/settings.tsx: a profile form (name, email, timezone), notification switches, and a danger zone that deletes the workspace after confirmation.
Build a sales dashboard page in src/pages/dashboard.tsx: four metric cards with week-on-week change, a revenue trend chart, and a sortable table of recent orders.
Build a pricing page in src/pages/pricing.tsx with three plans, a monthly/yearly switch, and a FAQ.
Build a support inbox page in src/pages/inbox.tsx: a list of conversations on the left, the selected conversation on the right, and a reply composer.
